annotations.title: Braille cells to BRF (embosser file text)

description:
Converts Unicode braille cells to BRF (NABCC 6-dot ASCII braille, the text format embossers read), with line/page wrapping (pronunciation-based, NOT an official national braille code.). 8-dot cells are converted to 6-dot by the engine and reported.
한국어: 유니코드 점자를 엠보서용 BRF 텍스트로 변환합니다.
name: braille_to_brf
